brief: Automated tech stack market intelligence engine and data analytics dashboard. Ingests live job postings from HiringCafe, maps multi-tier technology synergies and co-occurrence frequency, and benchmarks developer compensation.
criteria: Success: unmistakably identifiable at 16 px, zero reliance on faux-3D clip art, scalable across CLI terminals and web dashboards, authoritative developer presence.

concepts.name: Strata S
concepts.idea: An architectural S monogram sculpted from three horizontal tech strata with dynamic 45° chamfers.
rationale: Direct visual metaphor for the three tiers of modern tech stacks (UI, Logic, Infrastructure)
Precision 45° chamfered cuts evoke code syntax brackets and validation speed
Scores 100/100 in production geometry, scaling cleanly from 16 px favicons to terminal banners

recommendation: Strata S delivers an iconic, lasting developer identity that unifies the web dashboard, CLI, and portable application binary.
